description:
[Skins] A skin as Rust's own approved-skin list has it: workshop id, base item, flags, release batch. From Rust.Workshop.dll (Approved.cs) - exact, not matched by name: `workshopid`, `item` (base item shortname),
`tradable`, `marketable`, `crate_drop`, `twitch_drop`, `added` (the date of the store-update batch it shipped in) and
`batch`. 404 for skins older than the list (2015 workshop skins) or newer than the game build. Exact workshop id and flags from the game's own approved-skin list. Link https://rust.wiki/skin/<itemdefid>.

itemdefid.description: The skin's Steam item definition id.

name: get_skin_game_files
